dimensions.note: Provider-neutral, credential-free model with no network access.
Both methods log entry and completion or replay outcomes with structured placeholders and no sensitive values.
Policy, snapshots, and persisted state are validated before evaluation writes; deterministic outputs precede transition markers for safe retry.
Fourteen tests cover transitions, replay, freshness, malformed and duplicate evidence, stale policy/state, write ordering, evaluation compatibility, provenance, and denominator invariants.
Plans, inspections, incidents, and intents have deterministic identities; retries suppress completed transitions and safely overwrite pre-marker partial outputs.
No external API calls; caller-owned adapters supply normalized snapshots.
No network connections, subprocesses, file handles, temporary files, or external resources.
README, fixtures, manifest, and additional files use synthetic generic identifiers and disclose no private infrastructure.
All persisted resources and public contracts use strict Zod objects; no passthrough schemas.
Every resource declares an intentional lifetime and garbageCollection bound.
This is a read/evaluate transition model, not a CRUD lifecycle integration.
The model exposes no provider mutation, delivery, remediation, or network capability.
Plan, inspection, subject state, incident, and intent names are deterministic and spec-distinct; shared-spec writers use identical schemas.
Persisted state is read exclusively through context.readResource.
Initial unpublished release; no published state exists to migrate.
